options.name: TimeSinceApo
options.title: Months since the Apocalypse
options.description:
How long after the end of the world to begin.
This will affect starting world erosion and food spoilage.
Does not affect the starting date.

options.name: StartMonth
options.title: Start Month
options.description: Month in which the game starts.

options.name: StartDay
options.title: Start Day
options.description: Day of the month in which the games starts.

options.name: StartTime
options.title: Start Hour
options.description: Hour of the day in which the game starts.

options.name: Zombies
options.title: Zombie Count
options.description: Changing this also sets the "Population Multiplier" in Advanced Zombie Options.

options.name: Distribution
options.title: Zombie Distribution
options.description: How zombies are distributed across the map.

options.name: ZombieVoronoiNoise
options.title: Voronoi Noise
options.description: Controls whether some randomization is applied to zombie distribution.

options.name: ZombieRespawn
options.title: Zombie Respawn
options.description: How frequently new zombies are added to the world.

options.name: ZombieMigrate
options.title: Zombie Migration
options.description: Zombie allowed to migrate to empty cells.

options.name: ZombieLore.Speed
options.title: Speed
options.description: How fast zombies move.

options.name: ZombieLore.SprinterPercentage
options.title: Random Sprinter Amount
options.description:
If Random Speed is enabled, this controls what percentage of zombies are Sprinters.
Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom percentage.

options.name: ZombieLore.Strength
options.title: Strength
options.description: The damage zombies inflict per attack.

options.name: ZombieLore.Toughness
options.title: Toughness
options.description: The difficulty of killing a zombie.

options.name: ZombieLore.Transmission
options.title: Transmission
options.description: How the Knox Virus spreads.

options.name: ZombieLore.Mortality
options.title: Infection Mortality
options.description: How quickly the infection takes effect.

options.name: ZombieLore.Reanimate
options.title: Reanimate Time
options.description: How quickly infected corpses rise as zombies.

options.name: ZombieLore.Cognition
options.title: Cognition
options.description: Zombie intelligence.

options.name: ZombieLore.CrawlUnderVehicle
options.title: Crawl Under Vehicle
options.description: How often zombies can crawl under parked vehicles.

options.name: ZombieLore.Memory
options.title: Memory
options.description: How long zombies remember a player after seeing or hearing them.

options.name: ZombieLore.Sight
options.title: Sight
options.description: Zombie vision radius.

options.name: ZombieLore.Hearing
options.title: Hearing
options.description: Zombie hearing radius.

options.name: ZombieLore.SpottedLogic
options.title: New Stealth System
options.description: Activates the new advanced stealth mechanics, which allows you to hide from zombies behind cars, takes traits and weather into account, and much more.

options.name: ZombieLore.ThumpNoChasing
options.title: Environmental Attacks
options.description: If zombies that have not seen/heard player can attack doors and constructions while roaming.

options.name: ZombieLore.ThumpOnConstruction
options.title: Damage Construction
options.description: If zombies can destroy player constructions and defenses.

options.name: ZombieLore.ActiveOnly
options.title: Day/Night Zombie Speed Effect
options.description:
Whether zombies are more "active" during the day or night. 
"Active" zombies will use the speed set in the "Speed" setting. 
"Inactive" zombies will be slower, and tend not to give chase.

options.name: ZombieLore.TriggerHouseAlarm
options.title: Zombie House Alarm Triggering
options.description: If zombies trigger house alarms when breaking through windows or doors.

options.name: ZombieLore.ZombiesDragDown
options.title: Drag Down
options.description:
If multiple attacking zombies can drag you down and kill you. 
Dependent on zombie strength.

options.name: ZombieLore.ZombiesCrawlersDragDown
options.title: Crawlers Drag Down
options.description: If crawler zombies beside a player contribute to the chance of being dragged down and killed by a group of zombies.

options.name: ZombieLore.ZombiesFenceLunge
options.title: Zombie Lunge
options.description:
If zombies have a chance to lunge at you after climbing
over a fence or through a window if you're too close.

options.name: ZombieLore.DisableFakeDead
options.title: Fake Dead Zombie Reanimation
options.description: Whether some dead-looking zombies will reanimate and attack the player.

options.name: ZombieLore.ZombiesArmorFactor
options.title: Zombie Armor Factor
options.description: Serves as a multiplier when determining the effectiveness of armor worn by zombies.

options.name: ZombieLore.ZombiesMaxDefense
options.title: Maximum Zombie Armor Defense
options.description: The maximum defense percentage that any worn protective garments can provide to a zombie.

options.name: ZombieLore.ChanceOfAttachedWeapon
options.title: Chance Of Attached Weapon
options.description: Percentage chance of having a random attached weapon.

options.name: ZombieLore.ZombiesFallDamage
options.title: Zombie Fall Damage Multiplier
options.description: How much damage zombies take when falling from height.

options.name: ZombieLore.PlayerSpawnZombieRemoval
values: Inside the building and around it
options.title: Player Spawn Area
options.description: Zombies will not spawn where players spawn.

options.name: ZombieConfig.PopulationMultiplier
options.title: Population Multiplier
options.description:
Set by the "Zombie Count" population option, or by a custom number here.
Insane = 2.5, Very High = 1.6, High = 1.2, Normal = 0.65, Low = 0.15, None = 0.0.

options.name: ZombieConfig.PopulationStartMultiplier
options.title: Population Start Multiplier
options.description:
A multiplier for the desired zombie population at the start of the game.
Insane = 3.0, Very High = 2.0, High = 1.5, Normal = 1.0, Low = 0.5, None = 0.0.

options.name: ZombieConfig.PopulationPeakMultiplier
options.title: Population Peak Multiplier
options.description:
A multiplier for the desired zombie population on the peak day.
Insane = 3.0, Very High = 2.0, High = 1.5, Normal = 1.0, Low = 0.5, None = 0.0.

options.name: ZombieConfig.PopulationPeakDay
options.title: Population Peak Day
options.description: The day when the population reaches its peak.

options.name: ZombieConfig.RespawnHours
options.title: Respawn Hours
options.description:
The number of hours that must pass before zombies may respawn in a cell.
If 0, spawning is disabled.

options.name: ZombieConfig.RespawnUnseenHours
options.title: Respawn Unseen Hours
options.description: The number of hours that a chunk must be unseen before zombies may respawn in it.

options.name: ZombieConfig.RespawnMultiplier
options.title: Respawn Multiplier
options.description: The fraction of a cell's desired population that may respawn every RespawnHours.

options.name: ZombieConfig.RedistributeHours
options.title: Redistribute Hours
options.description:
The number of hours that must pass before zombies migrate
 to empty parts of the same cell.
If 0, migration is disabled.

options.name: ZombieConfig.FollowSoundDistance
options.title: Follow Sound Distance
options.description: The distance a zombie will try to walk towards the last sound it heard.

options.name: ZombieConfig.RallyGroupSize
options.title: Rally Group Size
options.description:
The size of groups real zombies form when idle. 0 means zombies don't form groups.
Groups don't form inside buildings or forest zones.

options.name: ZombieConfig.RallyGroupSizeVariance
options.title: Rally Group Size Variance
options.description: The amount, as a percentage, that zombie groups can vary in size from the default (both larger and smaller). \n For example, at 50% variance with a default group size of 20, groups will vary in size from 10-30.

options.name: ZombieConfig.RallyTravelDistance
options.title: Rally Travel Distance
options.description: The distance real zombies travel to form groups when idle.

options.name: ZombieConfig.RallyGroupSeparation
options.title: Rally Group Separation
options.description: The distance between zombie groups.

options.name: ZombieConfig.RallyGroupRadius
options.title: Rally Group Radius
options.description: How close members of a zombie group stay to the group's "leader".

options.name: ZombieConfig.ZombiesCountBeforeDelete
options.title: Zombie count before deletion
options.description:
Controls the maximum number of zombies tracked before cleanup occurs. 0 means zombies will not be cleaned up.
The default value (300) is strongly recommended. Increasing this value or setting to 0 may cause severe performance problems.
For troubleshooting and bug-report purposes, please reproduce any issue with the default setting before submitting a report.

options.name: HoursForLootRespawn
options.title: Hours for Loot Respawn
options.description:
When greater than 0, after X hours, all containers in towns and trailer parks in the world will respawn loot.
To spawn loot a container must have been looted at least once. Loot respawn is not impacted by visibility or subsequent looting.

options.name: SeenHoursPreventLootRespawn
options.title: Loot Seen Prevent Hours
options.description: When greater than 0, loot will not respawn in zones that have been visited within this number of in-game hours.

options.name: MaxItemsForLootRespawn
options.title: Max Items For Loot Respawn
options.description: Containers with a number of items greater, or equal to, this setting will not respawn.

options.name: ConstructionPreventsLootRespawn
options.title: Construction Prevents Loot Respawn
options.description: Items will not respawn in buildings that players have barricaded or built in.

options.name: MaximumLooted
options.title: Maximum Looted Building Chance
options.description:
The chance that any building will already be looted when found.
Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom number.

options.name: DaysUntilMaximumLooted
options.title: Days Until Max Looted Building Chance
options.description: How long it takes for Maximum Looted Building Chance to be reached.

options.name: RuralLooted
options.title: Rural Building Looted Chance Multiplier
options.description:
The chance that any rural building will already be looted when found.
Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom number.

options.name: MaximumDiminishedLoot
options.title: Maximum Diminished Loot Percentage
options.description:
The maximum loot that won't spawn when Days Until Maximum Diminished Loot is reached.
Check the "Advanced" box below to use an exact percentage.

options.name: DaysUntilMaximumDiminishedLoot
options.title: Days Until Maximum Diminished Loot
options.description: How long it takes for Maximum Diminished Loot Percentage to be reached.

options.name: MaximumLootedBuildingRooms
options.title: Maximum Looted Building Rooms
options.description: If a building has more than this amount of rooms it will not be looted.

options.name: FoodLootNew
options.title: Perishable Food
options.description: Any food that can rot or spoil.

options.name: CannedFoodLootNew
options.title: Non-Perishable Food
options.description: Canned and dried food, beverages.

options.name: WeaponLootNew
options.title: Melee Weapons
options.description: Weapons that are not tools in other categories.

options.name: RangedWeaponLootNew
options.title: Ranged Weapons
options.description: Also includes weapon attachments.

options.name: AmmoLootNew
options.title: Ammo
options.description: Loose ammo, boxes and magazines.

options.name: MedicalLootNew
options.title: Medical
options.description: Medicine, bandages and first aid tools.

options.name: SurvivalGearsLootNew
options.title: Survival Essentials
options.description: Fishing Rods, Tents, camping gear etc.

options.name: MechanicsLootNew
options.title: Mechanics
options.description: Vehicle parts and the tools needed to install them.

options.name: SkillBookLoot
options.title: Skill Books
options.description: Books that provide skill XP multipliers.

options.name: RecipeResourceLoot
options.title: Recipe Resources
options.description: Items that teach recipes.

options.name: LiteratureLootNew
options.title: Other Literature
options.description: All other items that can be read, including books, fliers, and newspapers.

options.name: ClothingLootNew
options.title: Clothing
options.description: All wearable items that are not containers.

options.name: ContainerLootNew
options.title: Bags
options.description: Backpacks and other wearable/equippable containers, eg. cases.

options.name: KeyLootNew
options.title: Keys
options.description: Keys for buildings/cars, key rings, and locks.

options.name: MediaLootNew
options.title: Media
options.description: VHS tapes and CDs.

options.name: MementoLootNew
options.title: Mementos
options.description: Spiffo items, plushies, and other collectible keepsake items eg. Photos.

options.name: CookwareLootNew
options.title: Cooking
options.description:
Items that are used in cooking, including those (eg. knives) which can be weapons. Does not include food.
Includes both usable and unusable items.

options.name: MaterialLootNew
options.title: Material
options.description:
Items and weapons that are used as ingredients for crafting or building.
This is a general category that does not include items belonging to other categories such as Cookware or Medical. Does not include Tools.

options.name: FarmingLootNew
options.title: Farming
options.description: Items and weapons which are used in both animal and plant agriculture, such as Seeds, Trowels, or Shovels.

options.name: ToolLootNew
options.title: Tools
options.description: Items and weapons which are Tools but don't fit in other categories such as Mechanics or Farming.

options.name: OtherLootNew
options.title: Other
options.description: Everything else. Also affects foraging for all items in Town/Road zones.

options.name: GeneratorSpawning
options.title: Generators
options.description: The chance of electrical generators spawning on the map.

options.name: LootItemRemovalList
options.title: Loot Item Removal List
options.description: A comma-separated list of item types that won't spawn as ordinary loot.

options.name: RemoveStoryLoot
options.title: Remove Unwanted Story Loot
options.description: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn in randomised world stories.

options.name: RemoveZombieLoot
options.title: Remove Unwanted Zombie Loot
options.description: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn worn by, or attached to, zombies.

options.name: RollsMultiplier
options.title: Rolls Multiplier [!]
options.description:
<BHC> [!] It is recommended that you DO NOT change this. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>

 Can be used to adjust the number of rolls made on loot tables when spawning loot. Will not reduce the number of rolls below 1. Can negatively affect performance if set to high values. It is highly recommended that this not be changed.

options.name: ZombiePopLootEffect
options.title: Zombie Population Loot Effect
options.description:
If greater than 0, the spawn of loot is increased relative to the number of nearby zombies, 
with the effect multiplied by this number.

options.name: WaterShutModifier
options.title: Water Shutoff
options.description: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that plumbing fixtures (eg. sinks) stop being infinite sources of water.

options.name: ElecShutModifier
options.title: Electricity Shutoff
options.description: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that the world's electricity turns off for good.

options.name: WaterShut
options.title: Water Shutoff
options.description: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that plumbing fixtures (eg. sinks) stop being infinite sources of water.

options.name: ElecShut
options.title: Electricity Shutoff
options.description: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that the world's electricity turns off for good.

options.name: AlarmDecay
options.title: Alarm Battery Decay
options.description: How long alarm batteries can last for after the power shuts off.

options.name: Alarm
options.title: House Alarms Frequency
options.description: How likely the player is to activate a house alarm when breaking into a new house.

options.name: LockedHouses
options.title: Locked Houses Frequency
options.description: How frequently the doors of homes and buildings will be locked when discovered.

options.name: FireSpread
options.title: Fire Spread
options.description: If fires spread when started.

options.name: AllowExteriorGenerator
options.title: Generator Working in Exterior
options.description:
If enabled, generators will work on exterior tiles. 
This will allow, for example, the powering of gas pumps.

options.name: GeneratorVerticalPowerRange
options.title: Generator vertical range
options.description: How many levels both above and below a generator it can provide with electricity.

options.name: FuelStationGasInfinite
options.title: Infinite Gas Pumps
options.description: If enabled, gas pumps will never run out of fuel

options.name: FuelStationGasMin
options.title: Initial Minimum Gas Pump Amount
options.description:
The minimum amount of gasoline that can spawn in gas pumps.
Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom amount.

options.name: FuelStationGasMax
options.title: Initial Maximum Gas Pump Amount
options.description:
The maximum amount of gasoline that can spawn in gas pumps.
Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom amount.

options.name: FuelStationGasEmptyChance
options.title: Initial Gas Pump Empty Chance
options.description: The chance, as a percentage, that individual gas pumps will initially have no fuel.

options.name: LightBulbLifespan
options.title: Light Bulb Lifespan
options.description:
The higher the value, the longer lightbulbs last before breaking. 
If 0, lightbulbs will never break. 
Does not affect vehicle headlights.

options.name: FoodRotSpeed
options.title: Food Spoilage
options.description: How fast that food will spoil, inside or outside of a fridge.

options.name: FridgeFactor
options.title: Refrigeration Effectiveness
options.description: How effective a fridge will be at keeping food fresh for longer.

options.name: DaysForRottenFoodRemoval
options.title: Rotten Food Removal
options.description:
Number of in-game days before rotten food is removed from the map. 
-1 means rotten food is never removed.

options.name: WorldItemRemovalList
options.default: Base.Hat, Base.Glasses, Base.Maggots, Base.Slug, Base.Slug2, Base.Snail, Base.Worm, Base.Dung_Mouse, Base.Dung_Rat
options.title: World Item Removal List
options.description: A comma-separated list of item types that will be removed after HoursForWorldItemRemoval hours.

options.name: HoursForWorldItemRemoval
options.title: Hours for Removal List
options.description:
Number of hours since an item was dropped on the ground before it is removed. 
Items are removed the next time that part of the map is loaded.  
Zero means items are not removed.

options.name: ItemRemovalListBlacklistToggle
options.title: Removal List as Whitelist
options.description: If true, any items *not* in WorldItemRemovalList will be removed.

options.name: Basement.SpawnFrequency
options.title: Basement Spawn Frequency
options.description: How frequently basements spawn at random locations.

options.name: MaximumFireFuelHours
options.title: Maximum Fire Fuel Hours
options.description: The maximum hours of fuel that can be placed in a campfire, wood stove etc.

options.name: NightDarkness
options.title: Darkness during night
options.description: The level of ambient lighting at night.

options.name: Temperature
options.title: Temperature
options.description: The global temperature.

options.name: Rain
options.title: Rain
options.description: How often it rains.

options.name: MaxFogIntensity
options.title: Maximum Fog Intensity
options.description: Maximum intensity of fog.

options.name: MaxRainFxIntensity
options.title: Maximum Rain FX Intensity
options.description: Maximum intensity of rain.

options.name: ErosionSpeed
options.title: Erosion Speed
options.description:
Number of days until the erosion system (which adds vines, long grass,
new trees etc. to the world) will reach 100% growth.

options.name: ErosionDays
options.title: Erosion Days
options.description:
For a custom Erosion Speed. Zero means use the Erosion Speed option.
Maximum is 36,500 days (approximately 100 years).

options.name: FarmingSpeedNew
options.title: Farming Speed
options.description: The speed of plant growth.

options.name: CompostTime
options.title: Compost Time
options.description: How long it takes for food to break down in a composter.

options.name: FishAbundance
options.title: Fishing Abundance
options.description: The abundance of fish in rivers and lakes.

options.name: NatureAbundance
options.title: Nature's Abundance
options.description: The abundance of items found in Foraging mode.

options.name: PlantResilience
options.title: Plant Resilience
options.description: How much water plants will lose per day, and their ability to avoid disease.

options.name: FarmingAmountNew
options.title: Farming Abundance
options.description: The abundance of harvested crops.

options.name: KillInsideCrops
options.title: Kill Crops Grown Inside
options.description: When enabled, crops and herbs grown inside buildings will die. Does not affect houseplants.

options.name: PlantGrowingSeasons
options.title: Plant Growing Seasons
options.description: When enabled, the growth of plants is affected by seasons.

options.name: PlaceDirtAboveground
options.title: Farms not on Ground Level [!]
options.description:
<BHC> [!] It is recommended that you DO NOT change this. Changing this can result in performance issues. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>

 When enabled, dirt can be placed, and farming performed on other than the ground level.

options.name: EnableSnowOnGround
options.title: Snow on Ground
options.description:
If snow will accumulate on the ground. 
If disabled, snow will still show on vegetation and rooftops.

options.name: EnableTaintedWaterText
options.title: Enable 'Tainted Water' tooltip
options.description: If tainted water will show a warning marking it as such.

options.name: MaximumRatIndex
options.title: Maximum Vermin Index
options.description: The frequency and intensity of eg. rats in infested buildings.

options.name: DaysUntilMaximumRatIndex
options.title: Days Until Maximum Vermin Index
options.description: How long it takes for the Maximum Vermin Index to be reached.

options.name: ClayLakeChance
options.title: Clay chance - Lake
options.description: Chance to turn a dirt floor into a clay floor. Applies to lakes.

options.name: ClayRiverChance
options.title: Clay chance - River
options.description: Chance to turn a dirt floor into a clay floor. Applies to rivers.

options.name: Helicopter
options.title: Helicopter
options.description: How regularly a helicopter passes over the Event Zone.

options.name: MetaEvent
options.title: Meta Event
options.description: How often zombie-attracting metagame events like distant gunshots will occur.

options.name: SleepingEvent
options.title: Sleeping Event
options.description: How often events during the player's sleep, like nightmares, occur.

options.name: GeneratorFuelConsumption
options.title: Generator Fuel Consumption
options.description: How much fuel is consumed by generators per in-game hour.

options.name: SurvivorHouseChance
options.title: Randomized Building Chance
options.description:
The chance of finding randomized buildings on the map (eg. burnt out houses, 
ones containing loot stashes or dead bodies).

options.name: VehicleStoryChance
options.title: Randomized Road Stories Chance
options.description: The chance of road stories (eg. police roadblocks) spawning.

options.name: ZoneStoryChance
options.title: Randomized Zone Stories Chance
options.description: The chance of stories specific to map zones (eg. a campsite in a forest) spawning.

options.name: AnnotatedMapChance
options.title: Annotated Map Chance
options.description: How often a looted map will have notes on it, written by a deceased survivor.

options.name: HoursForCorpseRemoval
options.title: Time Before Corpse Removal
options.description:
How long, in hours, before dead zombie bodies disappear from the world. 
If 0, maggots will not spawn on corpses.

options.name: DecayingCorpseHealthImpact
options.title: Decaying Corpse Health Impact
options.description: The impact that nearby decaying bodies has on the player's health and emotions.

options.name: ZombieHealthImpact
options.title: Zombie Health Impact
options.description: Whether nearby "living" zombies have the same impact on the player's health and emotions.

options.name: BloodLevel
options.title: Blood Level
options.description: How much blood is sprayed on floors and walls by injuries.

options.name: BloodSplatLifespanDays
options.title: Blood Splat Lifespan Days
options.description:
Number of days before old blood splats are removed.
Removal happens when map chunks are loaded.
0 means they will never disappear.

options.name: MaggotSpawn
options.title: Corpse Maggot Spawn
options.description: If/when maggots can spawn in corpses.

options.name: MetaKnowledge
options.title: Media List Meta Knowledge
options.description:
If a piece of media hasn't been fully seen or read, this setting determines
whether it's displayed fully, displayed as "???", or hidden completely.

options.name: DayNightCycle
options.title: Day / Night Cycle
options.description: Whether the time of day changes naturally, or it's always day/night.

options.name: ClimateCycle
options.title: Climate Cycle
options.description: Whether weather changes or remains at a single state.

options.name: FogCycle
options.title: Fog Cycle
options.description: Whether fog occurs naturally, never occurs, or is always present.

options.name: ZombieLore.FenceThumpersRequired
options.title: Zombies To Damage Fences
options.description: How many zombies it takes to damage a tall fence.

options.name: ZombieLore.FenceDamageMultiplier
options.title: Fence Damage Multiplier
options.description: How quickly zombies damage tall fences.

options.name: Map.AllowWorldMap
options.title: Allow World Map
options.description: If enabled, the world map can be accessed.

options.name: Map.AllowMiniMap
options.title: Allow Mini-Map
options.description: If enabled, a mini-map window will be available.

options.name: Map.MapAllKnown
options.title: All Known On Start
options.description: If enabled, the world map will be completely filled in on starting the game.

options.name: Map.MapNeedsLight
options.title: Light Needed To Read Map
options.description: If enabled, maps can't be read unless there's a source of light available.

options.name: StatsDecrease
options.title: Stats Decrease
options.description: How fast the player's hunger, thirst, and fatigue will decrease.

options.name: EndRegen
options.title: Endurance Regeneration
options.description: Recovery from being tired after performing actions.

options.name: Nutrition
options.title: Nutrition System
options.description: Nutritional value of food affects the player's condition. Turning this off will stop the player gaining or losing weight.

options.name: StarterKit
options.title: Starter Kit
options.description: Spawn with Chips, a Water Bottle, a Small Backpack, a Baseball Bat, and a Hammer.

options.name: CharacterFreePoints
options.title: Free Trait Points
options.description: Adds free points during character creation.

options.name: ConstructionBonusPoints
options.title: Player-built Construction Strength
options.description:
Gives player-built constructions extra hit points so they are 
more resistant to zombie damage.

options.name: InjurySeverity
options.title: Injury Severity
options.description: The impact that injuries have on your body, and their healing time.

options.name: BoneFracture
options.title: Bone Fracture
options.description: If survivors can get broken limbs from impacts, zombie damage, falls etc.

options.name: MuscleStrainFactor
options.title: Muscle Strain Factor
options.description: Functions as a multiplier when applying muscle strain from swinging weapons or carrying heavy loads.

options.name: DiscomfortFactor
options.title: Discomfort Factor
options.description: Functions as a multiplier when applying discomfort from worn items.

options.name: WoundInfectionFactor
options.title: Wound Infection Damage Factor
options.description: If greater than zero damage can be taken from serious wound infections.

options.name: ClothingDegradation
options.title: Clothing Degradation
options.description: How quickly clothing degrades, becomes dirty, and bloodied.

options.name: NoBlackClothes
options.title: No Black Clothes
options.description: If true clothing with randomized tints will not be so dark to be virtually black.

options.name: RearVulnerability
options.title: Rear Vulnerability
options.description: Chance of being bitten when a zombie attacks from behind.

options.name: MultiHitZombies
options.title: Weapon Multi Hit
options.description: If certain melee weapons will be able to strike multiple zombies in one hit.

options.name: FirearmUseDamageChance
options.title: Firearms Use Damage Chance
options.description: Replaces Chance-To-Hit mechanics with Chance-To-Damage calculations.  This mode prioritizes player aiming.

options.name: EnableVehicles
options.title: Vehicles
options.description: If vehicles will spawn.

options.name: VehicleEasyUse
options.title: Easy Use
options.description: Whether found vehicles are locked, need keys to start etc.

options.name: RecentlySurvivorVehicles
options.title: Recent Survivor Vehicles
options.description:
Whether a player can discover a car that has been cared for
 after the Knox infection struck.

options.title: Zombie Attraction Multiplier
options.description: General engine loudness to zombies.

options.description: How frequently vehicles can be discovered on the map.

options.name: ChanceHasGas
options.title: Chance Has Gas
options.description: The chance of finding a vehicle with gas in its tank.

options.name: InitialGas
options.title: Initial Gas
options.description: How full the gas tank of discovered vehicles will be.

options.name: CarGasConsumption
options.title: Gas Consumption
options.description: How gas-hungry vehicles are.

options.name: LockedCar
options.title: Locked Vehicle Frequency
options.description: How likely cars will be locked

options.name: CarGeneralCondition
options.title: General Condition
options.description: General condition discovered vehicles will be in.

options.name: TrafficJam
options.title: Car Wreck Congestion
options.description:
If traffic jams consisting of wrecked cars 
will appear on main roads.

options.name: CarAlarm
options.title: Vehicle Alarms Frequency
options.description: How frequently discovered vehicles have active alarms.

options.name: PlayerDamageFromCrash
options.title: Player Damage from Crash
options.description: If the player can get injured from being in a car accident.

options.name: CarDamageOnImpact
options.title: Car Damage on Impact
options.description: The amount of damage dealt to vehicles that crash.

options.name: SirenShutoffHours
options.title: Siren Shutoff Hours
options.description: How many in-game hours before a wailing siren shuts off.

options.name: DamageToPlayerFromHitByACar

options.description: Damage received by the player from being crashed into.

options.name: SirenEffectsZombies
options.title: Vehicle Sirens Attract Zombies
options.description: If zombies will head towards the sound of vehicle sirens.

options.name: AnimalStatsModifier
options.title: Stats Reduction Speed
options.description: Speed at which animals stats (hunger, thirst etc.) reduce.

options.name: AnimalPregnancyTime
options.title: Pregnancy Time
options.description: How long animals will be pregnant for before giving birth.

options.name: AnimalEggHatch
options.title: Egg Hatch Time
options.description: How long before baby animals will hatch from eggs.

options.name: AnimalAgeModifier
options.title: Aging Modifier Speed
options.description: Speed at which animals age.

options.name: AnimalRanchChance
options.title: Animal Spawn Chance
options.description: The chance of finding animals in farm.

options.name: AnimalGrassRegrowTime
options.title: Grass Regrowth time
options.description:
The number of hours grass will regrow after being
 eaten by an animal or cut by the player.

options.name: AnimalMetaPredator
options.title: Meta Predator
options.description:
If a meta (ie. not actually visible in-game) fox may attack 
your chickens if the hutch's door is left open at night.

options.name: AnimalMatingSeason
options.title: Breeding Season
options.description:
If on, animals will only mate during their breeding season (if any). 
Otherwise they can reproduce/lay eggs all year round.

options.name: AnimalSoundAttractZombies
options.title: Animals Attract Zombies
options.description: If true, animal calls will attract nearby zombies.

options.name: AnimalTrackChance
options.title: Animal Tracks Chance
options.description: The chance of animals leaving tracks.

options.name: AnimalPathChance
options.title: Animal Paths Chance
options.description: The chance of creating a path for animals to be hunted.

options.name: AlarmDecayModifier
options.title: Alarm Battery Decay
options.description: How long alarm batteries can last for after the power shuts off.

options.name: AnimalMetaStatsModifier
options.title: Meta Stats Reduction Speed
options.description: Speed at which animals stats (hunger, thirst etc.) reduce while in meta.

options.name: Farming

options.description: The speed of plant growth.

options.name: NightLength
options.title: Length of nights
options.description: The time from dusk to dawn.

options.name: PlantAbundance
